name: codex-ms-desktop-updater
description: Checks for Codex Desktop MSIX updates and keeps the local updater plugin current from GitHub.

interface.shortDescription: Check, download, and optionally install Codex MSIX updates.
interface.longDescription: Provides a PowerShell-based workflow for querying store.rg-adguard.net for the Codex Microsoft Store package, comparing versions, downloading MSIX packages, installing updates when requested, deleting verified installed package files to save storage, and keeping the local updater plugin current from GitHub by comparing plugin.json versions.
defaultPrompt: Install downloaded Codex update and restart
